model_provenance: New precommitted research hypotheses, NOT trained AI

frozen_rules.intraday: M5 trend-pullback + closed M15/H1 alignment, >2 prior corrective bars, displacement>=0.42 ATR, spread<=0.22 ATR
frozen_rules.extreme_scalping: fresh 20-M5 bar sweep and reclaim, >=0.45 ATR wick, >1.25x broker tick volume, spread<=0.12 ATR and H1 aligned
frozen_rules.priority: intraday first at same timestamp, extreme scalp only if no intraday there
frozen_rules.entry_exit: next M5 open + adverse 1 broker point each side, OHLC conservative SL-first, intraday max 48 M5, scalp max 8 M5
frozen_rules.targets: intraday 1.8R, scalp 1.3R; structural stop within ATR risk envelope
frozen_rules.fees: historical bar-based spread + 0.03R intraday / 0.06R scalp add-on; +0.10R and +0.20R independent cost stress
frozen_rules.timestamps: broker encoded epoch; historic timezone/DST UNVERIFIED

warnings: Fully scanned every available CLOSED M5 bar, but fast prefilter is a NEW rule-based candidate generator rather than every-candle heavy MarketDecisionPipeline
Prior historical 2025-2026 market data have been inspected in other experiments: NO independent holdout
